name: WebGL 2 Hardware Instancing
definition: A rendering technique that sends a single primitive (2x2x2 cube) to the GPU and executes gl.drawElementsInstanced to render hundreds of thousands of copies simultaneously, bypassing CPU bottlenecks by packing translation, scaling, and color data into flat Float32Arrays.
summary: WebGL 2 Hardware Instancing renders hundreds of thousands of voxel copies via gl.drawElementsInstanced, avoiding CPU bottlenecks by using explicit instance buffers rather than noise modulation.
